entities.name: Elder Ngabo
entities.description: A Jeskai elder of Jigme Village in Tarkir's original timeline who died after eating apple soup.

entities.name: Dar Chensal
entities.description: One of the Arbiter Twins who lit the lamp of guilt.

entities.name: Lotse Taring
entities.description: Accused of stealing apples and then of murdering Ngabo.

entities.name: Jigme Village
entities.description: Village where the trials took place.

events.summary: Ngabo calls the Arbiter Twins to Jigme Village to judge the theft of nine baskets of apples.
events.quote: Elder Ngabo called the Arbiter Twins, Kela and Dar Chensal to Jigme Village

events.summary: Dar lights his lamp of guilt, proclaiming Lotse Taring guilty of theft.
events.quote: until Dar lit his lamp of guilt

events.summary: At the celebration Ngabo tastes the apple soup, chokes and dies; villagers accuse Lotse of poisoning.
After a longer trial the twins find Lotse innocent of the murder; the truth is not revealed.
events.quote: it was determined that Lotse Taring was innocent of the murder of Elder Ngabo
